name: Custom Shape Engraved 3D LED Light with Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality clear acrylic combined with a sturdy wooden LED base, creating a clean, elegant, and modern decorative look.
    - The acrylic panel is made with a 5 mm thickness, providing durability and a premium transparent finish.
    - Features engraved artwork and personalized details on the acrylic surface, making each piece unique and meaningful.
    - The wooden base is designed with a built-in LED slot to securely hold the acrylic panel while illuminating the - engraved design beautifully.
    - USB-powered design makes it easy to use in bedrooms, living rooms, offices, or gift displays.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 acrylic panel size options:
               +) 5.9 x 5.9 in ~ 15 x 15 cm with 15 cm base
               +) 7.87 x 7.87 in ~ 20 x 20 cm with 20 cm base
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the acrylic panel may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - Uses precise acrylic engraving technology to create clear, detailed, and elegant line-art designs.
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology on a wooden base for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized keepsake and a decorative LED night light.
    - Creates a soft glowing effect that enhances engraved names, portraits, and meaningful messages.
    - Ideal for decorating bedrooms, desks, shelves, living rooms, and workspaces.
    - Makes a beautiful display piece for anniversaries, weddings, family memories, graduations, and memorial moments.
    - USB connection makes it easy to plug into laptops, power banks, wall adapters, or other USB-compatible devices.
    - A stylish and sentimental décor item that adds warmth and personality to any space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, family members, parents, children, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for anniversaries, weddings, Valentine’s Day, birthdays, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, graduations, housewarmings, and Christmas.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for celebrating family memories, relationship milestones, and special life moments.
    - Great for anyone who loves custom home décor, sentimental gifts, and personalized night lights.
    - Combines emotional value with decorative beauty, making it a memorable and practical gift choice.
    - A unique custom gift that lights up treasured moments in a beautiful way🎁

 

  • LED Light Features:
    - USB powered for convenient everyday use.
    - Available with monochrome lighting or 7-color LED lighting, depending on the selected option.
    - 7 LED colors include: red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, purple, and white.
    - Can display fixed single-color light or colorful gradient mode.
    - Supports fast and slow color-changing modes.
    - Includes brightness adjustment:
               +) Press “+” or “-” to adjust brightness
               +) Press the middle button to turn on/off
    - Features a memory function, remembering the last brightness level and light color used.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Engraved 3D LED Light with Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
